name: Premier Paints Plc
source: Premier Paints Plc audited report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGX corporate disclosure, quarter 5 filing, March 2026). Revenue, profit before tax, income tax, profit after tax and earnings per share are the audited five-year financial summary on page 52; cost of sales is note 4.1 on page 41 and replaces an earlier stored row that carried the depreciation charge from note 4.5
unit: NGN, printed in N thousands and converted to naira; earnings per share as printed (the report labels the row kobo, but 1,993 on 123,000 thousand shares is 0.0162 naira, which the audited summary prints as 0.02)

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.derivedFrom: Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

derivation.note: rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures, not printed in the source. Cost of Sales was corrected: the stored row carried the 7,791 and 7,954 thousand naira depreciation charge disclosed in note 4.5 as cost of sales, which printed a 94.74 percent gross margin; note 4.1 states cost of sales of 111,552 and 102,738 thousand naira
